\"unknown\"\n                    },\n                    FailureReason: settleResponse.FailureReason);\n            }\n\n            transaction.MarkSettled(settleResponse.ProviderReference);\n            await PersistAndPublishAsync(transaction, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);\n\n            return new PaymentResult(transaction, true, settleResponse.ProviderReference, null);\n        }\n\n        #region Private helpers\n\n        private async Task PersistAndPublishAsync(PaymentTransaction transaction, CancellationToken token)\n        {\n            await _transactionRepository.UpdateAsync(transaction, token).ConfigureAwait(false);\n            await _domainEventPublisher.PublishAsync(transaction.DomainEvents, token).ConfigureAwait(false);\n        }\n\n        #endregion\n    }\n\n    #endregion\n\n    #region Exceptions\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Thrown when a payment transaction cannot be located in persistence layer.\n    /// </summary>\n    public sealed class PaymentNotFoundException : Exception\n    {\n        public PaymentNotFoundException(Guid transactionId)\n            : base($\"Payment transaction '{transactionId}' could not be found.\") { }\n    }\n\n    #endregion\n}\n\n```","numLines":402,"startLine":1,"totalLines":402}}}

Architecture (Ports and Adapters) Identification\n\nThe TempoScribe Pro codebase is a textbook implementation of **Hexagonal Architecture** (also known as **Ports and Adapters**). The architecture clearly separates:\n\n1. **Domain Layer (Core)**: Contains pure business logic with no dependencies on external frameworks or infrastructure. Entities like `Post`, `PaymentTransaction`, and value objects like `Money`, `PostId` reside here. Domain services orchestrate business workflows.\n\n2. **Ports**: Interfaces that define contracts between the application core and the outside world:\n   - **Inbound/Driving Ports**: Interfaces that expose application capabilities to external actors (e.g., `IScheduledPublishingService`, `IPremiumAccessService`)\n   - **Outbound/Driven Ports**: Interfaces that the application uses to interact with external systems (e.g., `IPostRepository`, `IPaymentGateway`, `ICacheProvider`, `IEventBus`)\n\n3. **Adapters**: Concrete implementations that connect the hexagon to the real world:\n   - **Primary/Driving Adapters**: ASP.NET Core Controllers, Quartz.NET job adapters, Hangfire triggers\n   - **Secondary/Driven Adapters**: `StripePaymentGatewayAdapter`, `RedisCacheProvider`, EF Core repositories, `InMemoryCacheAdapter`\n\n### Key Architectural Patterns Observed\n\n1. **Dependency Inversion**: The domain/application core defines interfaces (ports), and infrastructure implements them (adapters). Dependencies flow inward toward the domain.\n\n2. **Constructor Injection**: All services receive their dependencies through constructors, enabling testability and loose coupling.\n\n3. **Technology Agnosticism**: Domain services like `ScheduledPublishingService` have no knowledge of Stripe, Redis, EF Core, or any specific technology.\n\n4. **Resilience Patterns**: Adapters use Polly retry policies for transient fault handling.\n\n5. **Configuration via Options Pattern**: Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration with strongly-typed option classes (`PaymentProcessingOptions`, `CacheOptions`).\n\n---\n\n## Part 1: Architectural Analysis\n\n### 1. aggregator API (`https://api.content-aggregator.com/v1/posts`) via HTTP POST upon successful publication.\n\n### Step-by-Step Implementation Plan\n\n#### Step 1: Define the New Port (Interface)\n\n**New File**: `src/Domain/Ports/IContentSyndicator.cs` (or add to existing ports module)\n\n```csharp\nnamespace TempoScribePro.Domain.Ports\n{\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Outbound port for syndicating published content to external aggregators.\n    /// </summary>\n    public interface IContentSyndicator\n    {\n        /// <summary>\n        /// Syndicates a published post to an external content aggregator.\n        /// </summary>\n        /// <param name=\"post\">The published post to syndicate.</param>\n        /// <param name=\"cancellationToken\">Cancellation token.</param>\n        /// <returns>Result indicating success or failure of syndication.</returns>\n        Task<SyndicationResult> SyndicateAsync(\n            Post post,\n            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);\n    }\n\n    public sealed record SyndicationResult(\n        bool IsSuccess,\n        string? ExternalId,\n        string? ErrorMessage);\n}\n```\n\n**Purpose**: This interface belongs in the Domain/Application layer and defines the contract for content syndication without any knowledge of HTTP, REST, or specific external APIs.\n\n**Location in Hexagon**: Outbound Port (driven port)\n\n#### Step 2: Create the Secondary Adapter (HTTP Client Implementation)\n\n**New File**: `src/Infrastructure/Syndication/ContentAggregatorSyndicatorAdapter.cs`\n\n```csharp\nnamespace TempoScribePro.Infrastructure.Syndication\n{\n    /// <summary>\n    /// HTTP adapter that syndicates posts to the external content aggregator API.\n    /// Implements the <see cref=\"IContentSyndicator\"/> port.\n    /// </summary>\n    public sealed class ContentAggregatorSyndicatorAdapter : IContentSyndicator\n    {\n        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;\n        private readonly ContentSyndicationOptions _options;\n        private readonly ILogger<ContentAggregatorSyndicatorAdapter> _logger;\n        private readonly AsyncRetryPolicy<HttpResponseMessage> _retryPolicy;\n\n        public ContentAggregatorSyndicatorAdapter(\n            HttpClient httpClient,\n            IOptions<ContentSyndicationOptions> options,\n            ILogger<ContentAggregatorSyndicatorAdapter> logger)\n        {\n            _httpClient = httpClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(httpClient));\n            _options = options?.Value ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(options));\n            _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));\n\n            // Configure Polly retry for transient HTTP failures\n            _retryPolicy = Policy<HttpResponseMessage>\n                .Handle<HttpRequestException>()\n                .OrResult(r => r.StatusCode >= HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError)\n                .WaitAndRetryAsync(\n                    retryCount: 3,\n                    sleepDurationProvider: attempt => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Pow(2, attempt)));\n        }\n\n        public async Task<SyndicationResult> SyndicateAsync(\n            Post post,\n            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)\n        {\n            var payload = new\n            {\n                title = post.Title,\n                slug = post.Slug,\n                content = post.MarkdownBody,\n                publishedAt = post.PublishedAtUtc,\n                author = post.AuthorName,\n                isPremium = post.IsPremium\n            };\n\n            var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload);\n            var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, \"application/json\");\n\n            _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization =\n                new AuthenticationHeaderValue(\"Bearer\", _options.ApiKey);\n\n            try\n            {\n                var response = await _retryPolicy.ExecuteAsync(async ct =>\n                    await _httpClient.PostAsync(_options.EndpointUrl, content, ct),\n                    cancellationToken);\n\n                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)\n                {\n                    var responseBody = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);\n                    var result = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SyndicationApiResponse>(responseBody);\n\n                    _logger.LogInformation(\n                        \"Post {PostId} syndicated successfully. ExternalId: {ExternalId}\",\n                        post.Id, result?.Id);\n\n                    return new SyndicationResult(true, result?.Id, null);\n                }\n\n                var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);\n                _logger.LogWarning(\n                    \"Syndication failed for Post {PostId}. Status: {StatusCode}, Error: {Error}\",\n                    post.Id, response.StatusCode, error);\n\n                return new SyndicationResult(false, null, error);\n            }\n            catch (Exception ex)\n            {\n                _logger.LogError(ex, \"Syndication exception for Post {PostId}\", post.Id);\n                return new SyndicationResult(false, null, ex.Message);\n            }\n        }\n\n        private sealed record SyndicationApiResponse(string? Architecture (Ports and Adapters) Identification\n\nThe TempoScribe Pro codebase is a textbook implementation of **Hexagonal Architecture** (also known as **Ports and Adapters**). The architecture clearly separates:\n\n1. **Domain Layer (Core)**: Contains pure business logic with no dependencies on external frameworks or infrastructure. Entities like `Post`, `PaymentTransaction`, and value objects like `Money`, `PostId` reside here. Domain services orchestrate business workflows.\n\n2. **Ports**: Interfaces that define contracts between the application core and the outside world:\n   - **Inbound/Driving Ports**: Interfaces that expose application capabilities to external actors (e.g., `IScheduledPublishingService`, `IPremiumAccessService`)\n   - **Outbound/Driven Ports**: Interfaces that the application uses to interact with external systems (e.g., `IPostRepository`, `IPaymentGateway`, `ICacheProvider`, `IEventBus`)\n\n3. **Adapters**: Concrete implementations that connect the hexagon to the real world:\n   - **Primary/Driving Adapters**: ASP.NET Core Controllers, Quartz.NET job adapters, Hangfire triggers\n   - **Secondary/Driven Adapters**: `StripePaymentGatewayAdapter`, `RedisCacheProvider`, EF Core repositories, `InMemoryCacheAdapter`\n\n### Key Architectural Patterns Observed\n\n1. **Dependency Inversion**: The domain/application core defines interfaces (ports), and infrastructure implements them (adapters). Dependencies flow inward toward the domain.\n\n2. **Constructor Injection**: All services receive their dependencies through constructors, enabling testability and loose coupling.\n\n3. **Technology Agnosticism**: Domain services like `ScheduledPublishingService` have no knowledge of Stripe, Redis, EF Core, or any specific technology.\n\n4. **Resilience Patterns**: Adapters use Polly retry policies for transient fault handling.\n\n5. **Configuration via Options Pattern**: Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration with strongly-typed option classes (`PaymentProcessingOptions`, `CacheOptions`).\n\n---\n\n## Part 1: Architectural Analysis\n\n### 1. Inbound | Service contract |\n\n---\n\n## Part 2: Implementation Plan for Content Syndication Feature\n\n### Feature Overview\nAutomatically syndicate published blog posts to an external content IContentSyndicator\n    {\n        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;\n        private readonly ContentSyndicationOptions _options;\n        private readonly ILogger<ContentAggregatorSyndicatorAdapter> _logger;\n        private readonly AsyncRetryPolicy<HttpResponseMessage> _retryPolicy;\n\n        public ContentAggregatorSyndicatorAdapter(\n            HttpClient httpClient,\n            IOptions<ContentSyndicationOptions> options,\n            ILogger<ContentAggregatorSyndicatorAdapter> logger)\n        {\n            _httpClient = httpClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(httpClient));\n            _options = options?.Value ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(options));\n            _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));\n\n            // Configure Polly retry for transient HTTP failures\n            _retryPolicy = Policy<HttpResponseMessage>\n                .Handle<HttpRequestException>()\n                .OrResult(r => r.StatusCode >= HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError)\n                .WaitAndRetryAsync(\n                    retryCount: 3,\n                    sleepDurationProvider: attempt => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Pow(2, attempt)));\n        }\n\n        public async Task<SyndicationResult> SyndicateAsync(\n            Post post,\n            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)\n        {\n            var payload = new\n            {\n                title = post.Title,\n                slug = post.Slug,\n                content = post.MarkdownBody,\n                publishedAt = post.PublishedAtUtc,\n                author = post.AuthorName,\n                isPremium = post.IsPremium\n            };\n\n            var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload);\n            var content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, \"application/json\");\n\n            _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization =\n                new AuthenticationHeaderValue(\"Bearer\", _options.ApiKey);\n\n            try\n            {\n                var response = await _retryPolicy.ExecuteAsync(async ct =>\n                    await _httpClient.PostAsync(_options.EndpointUrl, content, ct),\n                    cancellationToken);\n\n                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)\n                {\n                    var responseBody = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);\n                    var result = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SyndicationApiResponse>(responseBody);\n\n                    _logger.LogInformation(\n                        \"Post {PostId} syndicated successfully. ExternalId: {ExternalId}\",\n                        post.Id, result?.Id);\n\n                    return new SyndicationResult(true, result?.Id, null);\n                }\n\n                var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);\n                _logger.LogWarning(\n                    \"Syndication failed for Post {PostId}. Status: {StatusCode}, Error: {Error}\",\n                    post.Id, response.StatusCode, error);\n\n                return new SyndicationResult(false, null, error);\n            }\n            catch (Exception ex)\n            {\n                _logger.LogError(ex, \"Syndication exception for Post {PostId}\", post.Id);\n                return new SyndicationResult(false, null, ex.Message);\n            }\n        }\n\n        private sealed record SyndicationApiResponse(string? Id);\n    }\n}\n```\n\n**Purpose**: Concrete implementation that handles all HTTP-specific concerns (HttpClient, JSON serialization, retry policies, authentication headers).\n\n**Location in
